dct_title_s: Montserrat, particulars of valuable Sugar Estates : known as the Streatham Estate consisting of upper and lower Streatham, and Ryley's Estates, in the Parish of St. Anthony and St. George : the Windward or White's Estate, consisting of White's and Hermitage Estates, in the parishes of St. George and St. Patrick, in the Island of Montserrat, containing together 1.294 acres, or thereabouts, together with the buildings, fixtures, machinery & live & dead stock thereon : which will be sold by auction, in two lots, by Messrs. Hards & Jenkinson, before James Fleming, Esq., Q.C., and Reginald John Cust, Esq., Commissioners for Sale of Incumbered Estates in the West Indies, at the Sale Room of the Commissioners
